changelog:
**Summary: Adds mandatory privacy warnings and explicit user confirmation before all scans.**

- Added strict privacy warning: all scans may share data with VirusTotal and its security partners; warns against submitting confidential or proprietary materials.
- Now requires explicit user confirmation prior to sending any file, URL, domain, or IP—no exceptions.
- Strongly encourages hash-based lookups before file uploads, to avoid sharing full files when possible.
- Removed the generic "is this safe" trigger to prevent accidental, unintended data submission.
- Updated documentation to make all privacy, consent, and data handling requirements clear to users.
